node.title: M720 remaining off-laptop gate replay
node.statement: The M720 gate arithmetic reproduces the remaining banked calibration facts by combining the local h=5 n=32 replay with the two large h=3 rows: full_census(128,3,17921)=18 anchored cores, full_census(256,3,65537)=129 anchored cores, and full_census(32,5,97)=96 trades.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the locally proved h=5 n=32 row and the still off-laptop h=3 large replay
node.falsifier: any remaining gate replay returning a different count, or a corrected banked calibration table
